item.description: Aguia Resources secures Tres Estradas concession, targeting May 2026 production; Pampafos launch underway as Colombian gold ops improve.

item.title: DorsaVi Advances Edge AI and Robotics Strategy with 22nm RRAM Tests
item.description: DorsaVi kicks off 180-nm RRAM testing as it targets a 22-nm edge AI/robotics platform, boosting neuromorphic ambitions amid FY25 revenue decline.

item.title: Felix Gold Reports High-Grade Antimony Extensions at Treasure Creek in Alaska
item.description: Felix Gold expands high-grade antimony at Treasure Creek, Alaska, with shallow intercepts up to 12.53% Sb and a gold halo, boosting US supply potential.

item.title: Forte Energy Completes Acquisition of Large Oil Lease Position in Alaska
item.description: Forte Energy clinches 143,368-acre Alaska NPR-A lease position; 2026 suspension cuts ~$430k fees, fueling farmouts as Harrier targets >1B barrels.

item.title: EVE Health Group Raises $0.9m to Advance Reformulated Pharmaceutical Pipeline
item.description: EVE Health Group raises $0.904m via placement to push reformulated drug delivery pipeline, accelerating IP, regulatory work and licensing talks.

item.title: Uranium Needs to be Discussed: Big tech demand meets structural deficit
item.description: Uranium rally as AI data centers and SMRs power multi-million tech PPAs; looming structural deficit puts uranium in focus for investors.

item.description: Immutep halts TACTI-004 Phase III in first-line NSCLC due to futility; shares resume trading as cash runway extends beyond Q2 CY2027.

item.description: Everest Metals eyes near-term production after bonanza-grade RC results at Mt Dimer Taipan, with 45,000t ROM and April 2026 processing.

item.description: Syrah Resources avoids US AD/CVD tariffs after ITC's negative ruling on Chinese graphite; Vidalia AAM sales may be delayed despite ready capacity.
